messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
As of 20 January 2027, which models in the catalogue that are currently self-certified through internal checks will require a notified body?

response.text: A partire dal 20 gennaio 2027, quali modelli presenti nel catalogo, attualmente autocertificati tramite controlli interni, richiederanno un organismo notificato?
